# gcore_dns_network_mappings (Data Source)

DNS network mappings associate CIDR ranges with network tags for private DNS resolution and traffic-based routing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_dns_network_mappings" "example_dns_network_mappings" {
  order_by = "order_by"
  order_direction = "asc"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `order_by` (String) Field name to sort by
- `order_direction` (String) Ascending or descending order
Available values: "asc", "desc".

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number)
- `mapping` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--mapping))
- `name` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--items--mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.mapping`

Read-Only:

- `cidr4` (List of String)
- `cidr6` (List of String)
- `tags` (List of String)
